title: Go fish
tagline: Ask for cards, collect sets of four, go fish.
teaser: Ask the computer for a rank you hold; if it has none, go fish. Collect the most books of four to win.

manPage.synopsis: fish — ask for ranks, draw when told, collect books of four.
manPage.description: Muffy Barkocy’s go fish for BSD, the gentlest card game in the directory.

howToPlay: Ask the computer for a rank you already hold.
If it has none, go fish from the pile.
Collect the most sets of four to win.
